what: ab_contig.c: the binary32 attention's forward and backward, the arms in one process on one set of buffers in rotated rounds after a warm one, 24 rounds every row, each arm's pool made outside the clock: before (the tree before, its entries), after (the tree after built with -DBCIR_ATT_CONTIG_FROM=copies_from, its workspace entries lent the pool's need), in-place (the tree after, its entries without a workspace), bound (the tree after on the contiguous layout, B*H batches of one head: nothing to copy, the most a layout change could take) and A/A (before again); each ratio an arm's time over before's in the same round, the geometric mean and its 95% interval over the rounds; shape [B, T, H, D], H heads and as many KV heads, contract 0 v1, 2 FUSED; the threshold's runs: the copies from T512, below the committed threshold of 1024 (the T1024 rows of attention.json are the committed threshold's own)

first_run.what: the run that set the threshold, 24 rounds a row: the same instrument on the provisional commit before this one (its default threshold 2048; the copies' code the committed one), its unit built to copy from T1024 and from T512 -- copying from T1024 read faster, from T512 not
